This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. /p p Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria. /p p Just as importantly, you want to get better. We re looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time. /p p strong The Key Skills we are looking for: /strong /p ul li strong Practical experience with Cypress /strong — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. jobs.title: Senior Manager, QA Engineering
jobs.desc: Register Here! Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda is hiring a Senior Manager, QA Engineering to lead the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8 — elevating quality governance with rigorous quality gates, outcome-driven automation, and strategic reporting that guides roadmap and release decisions. They will manage two teams (functional and reliability) comprising 12 ICs, a principal engineer, and a manager; evolve the structure for scale; and ensure comprehensive coverage across business users, developers, and admins/operators in Kubernetes, cloud, and bare-metal environments. This first-of-its-kind role reports directly to the VP of Engineering. What you'll be doing: Own and drive the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8, establishing quality gates and cross-team accountability. Partner with principal engineering to mature reliability, performance, and resilience testing. Guide automation strategy and QA processes to enable teams to deliver high-quality outcomes efficiently. Develop actionable quality metrics, dashboards, and reports that inform leadership and roadmap decisions. Lead and scale QA teams — managers, principal engineers, and ICs — evolving structure for maximum impact. Influence cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, product, UX, documentation, field) to embed quality across the organization. What you bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product . Proven track record leading QA in engineering organizations of 100–500 people, with measurable impact. Ability to define and implement end-to-end QA strategy, quality gates, and data-informed decision-making across multiple teams. Comfort staying connected to hands-on QA execution while leading strategically. Experience leveling up QA for complex technical products, including developer/admin persona coverage and high-load, performance, resilience testing. Skill aligning engineering, product, UX, documentation, and field teams around shared quality goals. Enterprise software / workflow automation background. Nice-to-haves: Deep understanding of Kubernetes, cloud, microservices, and related operational challenges. Hands-on experience with Playwright, TestRail, or CI/CD-integrated testing environments. Chaos engineering or advanced reliability/performance benchmarking experience. Proven ability to drive cultural change in QA. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. Benefits Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Remote Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets , including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
